documents.abstract: We report synthesis, in vitro antiviral activity, and stability studies in biological media of original boranophosphonate isosteres of AZT and d4T monophophates. A convenient route for the synthesis of 3'-Azido-3'-deoxythymidine-5'-boranophosphonate 8 and 2',3'-Didehydro-3'-dideoxythymidine-5'-boranophosphonate 12 is described. H-phosphinates 7 and 11, and alpha-boranophosphonates 8 and 12 exhibited no significant in vitro activity against HIV-infected cells, neither against a broad panel of viruses, up to 200 microM. The absence of activity of target compounds 8 and 12 can be partially explained by their short half-life in culture medium.
documents.authors: Barral K, Priet S, De Michelis C, Sire J, Neyts J, Balzarini J, Canard B, Alvarez K.
documents.title: Synthesis and antiviral activity of boranophosphonate isosteres of AZT and d4T monophosphates.
